nodes.title: Every Hero Starts Somewhere
nodes.summary: MC accepts a routine wild-boar request from Primora's local guild post, showing an earnest desire to become a hero without grand destiny or prophecy.

beats.title: A Small Request
beats.screenAction: MC accepts a low-risk wild-boar request at Primora's guild post before leaving for the nearby forest.
beats.dialogueIntent: Establish MC's hero aspiration lightly and quickly; keep village life ordinary.
beats.result: MC leaves Primora carrying the ordinary starting sword and a routine request.

script.text: Morning light settles over Primora Village. A small request board stands beside the guild post.
Wild boar. North trail. That's it?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Try not to sound disappointed. Most people like easy work.
script.speaker: Guild Clerk

script.text: Every hero has to start somewhere.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: The clerk gives MC a look that is more amused than convinced.
Then start by coming back in one piece.
script.speaker: Guild Clerk

script.text: Player receives the routine wild-boar request and leaves Primora with the starting sword.
PRO-B01 — A Simple Hunt.

nodes.title: A Simple Hunt
nodes.summary: A routine wild-boar request teaches basic movement and sword combat before an abnormal threat interrupts the hunt.

beats.title: Routine Work
beats.screenAction: MC handles the expected low-threat target until a much heavier presence enters the area.
beats.dialogueIntent: Keep the first fight simple and ordinary so the later chimera feels genuinely wrong.
beats.result: The ordinary tutorial threat is resolved and the anomalous creature interrupts the hunt.

script.text: Tutorial battle begins. Teach movement and the basic sword attack against an ordinary wild boar.
The boar circles through brush and charges.
Come on. I've handled worse training dummies than you.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: MC drives the boar off the trail and regains control of the clearing.
A heavier impact sounds deeper in the forest. Birds scatter.
...That wasn't the boar.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: The tutorial objective clears, but something much larger pushes through the trees.
PRO-B02 — The Wrong Beast.

nodes.title: The Wrong Beast
nodes.summary: The failed chimera breaks MC's starting sword and injures MC. The encounter becomes an escape sequence ending in an accidental crossing through a small Fracture.

beats.title: The Wrong Target
beats.screenAction: The anomalous chimera appears. MC attacks, the creature intercepts the strike, breaks the sword, and throws MC back.
beats.dialogueIntent: Destroy MC's confidence quickly; the creature behaves as a dangerous physical threat, not a speaking villain.
beats.result: MC is injured, the sword is broken, and direct fighting is no longer viable.

script.text: A failed chimera forces its way between the trees: bear-like body, four powerful forelimbs, and a bull-like head.
...That's not a boar.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Objective: Assess the threat. MC still has normal Attack.
MC steps in and commits to a sword strike.
The creature intercepts the blade with brutal force.
The starting sword snaps. MC is hurled backward and hits the ground.
...Okay.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Running sounds good.
script.speaker: MC

beats.title: Escape
beats.screenAction: MC flees through the forest while injured and attack-limited, then tumbles through a visible refractive Fracture by accident.
beats.dialogueIntent: Keep the escape immediate. Do not explain the Fracture, chimera origin, or destination selection.
beats.result: MC crosses the Fracture with clothing and carried gear; the destination remains unknown.

script.text: Objective changes to ESCAPE. Normal Attack is disabled; movement and route interaction remain available.
MC runs through the forest while the chimera pursues as an aggressive predator.
Branches tear at MC's clothes. Blood runs from the arm and forehead.
The ground drops sharply ahead. MC slips, tumbles down the slope, and sees a strange refractive shimmer between the trees.
What is—
script.speaker: MC

script.text: MC rolls through the distortion before there is time to stop.
The forest vanishes in a wash of bent light.
CH01-N01 — The Other Side.

nodes.title: The Other Side
nodes.summary: MC emerges from the Fracture injured and disoriented, is found by civilians/local escorts traveling with Julie d’Aubigny, receives Julie's practical aid, learns that Primora and Vaelkrath are unknown, and joins the group before road danger escalates into CH01-B01.

beats.title: Fracture Arrival
beats.screenAction: MC crashes into unfamiliar wooded farmland, still injured and carrying the broken starting sword. The small Fracture collapses without obvious trace.
beats.dialogueIntent: Pain and disorientation only; no cosmology explanation.
beats.result: MC is conscious, mobile, and still unable to make normal attacks.

script.text: A sharp shimmer folds in on itself behind MC and vanishes.
MC hits the ground hard and lies still for a moment.
MC pushes up, sees blood on one arm, then looks at the broken sword.
Still broken. Great.
script.speaker: MC

beats.title: Toward the Road
beats.screenAction: MC moves toward a nearby road after hearing a cart beyond the trees.
beats.dialogueIntent: MC assumes this is some unfamiliar region reached during the fall, not another world.
beats.result: A traveling group becomes audible and visible.

script.text: Player regains movement control. MC can move but cannot use a normal attack.
A cart wheel creaks beyond the trees.
People?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: MC heads toward the road, favoring the injured arm.

beats.title: The Group Finds MC
beats.screenAction: A small civilian/local-escort group finds MC. Julie is already traveling with them and notices the injuries.
beats.dialogueIntent: Caution from the escort; Julie's attention goes immediately to the visible injury.
beats.result: Julie becomes the first notable France character to take direct interest in MC.

script.text: The cart slows. One escort steps forward while the civilians keep their distance.
Stop there.
script.speaker: Local escort

script.text: I'm not looking for trouble.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Then put the sword down.
script.speaker: Local escort

script.text: MC looks at the broken blade.
This?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: A young woman notices the blood on MC's sleeve and forehead.
They're hurt.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

beats.title: Julie Helps
beats.screenAction: Julie steps past the escort, checks MC's arm, and directs immediate aid before asking for an explanation.
beats.dialogueIntent: Practical compassion with restrained humor; no dramatic rescue speech.
beats.result: Julie personally helps MC despite not knowing who MC is.

script.text: The young woman kneels beside MC and holds out a hand.
Give me your arm.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: I'm fine.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: You're terrible at lying.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Can you move your fingers?
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Yeah.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Good. Keep it still.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: We still don't know who they are.
script.speaker: Local escort

script.text: Then ask after they stop bleeding.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: ...Thank you.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: You can thank me when you stop swaying.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

beats.title: Foreign Words
beats.screenAction: The introduction itself reveals that the group's speech sounds foreign even though its meaning reaches MC clearly.
beats.dialogueIntent: Show the language anomaly with one sharp contradiction rather than a long explanation.
beats.result: MC realizes mutual spoken understanding is happening despite genuinely different languages.

script.text: Name?
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: {{MC_NAME}}. I'm from Primora.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: The group trades blank looks. MC listens more carefully to the young woman's voice.
Wait... what language are you speaking?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: French.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: ...What's French?
script.speaker: MC

beats.title: Primora and Vaelkrath
beats.screenAction: MC names Primora and Vaelkrath; nobody recognizes either place.
beats.dialogueIntent: The locals are genuinely unfamiliar; Julie does not ridicule or accuse MC.
beats.result: MC gets the first major contradiction while still resisting an impossible explanation.

script.text: Primora Village. Vaelkrath. Neither of those means anything to you?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Never heard of either.
script.speaker: Civilian

script.text: Nor me.
script.speaker: Local escort

script.text: I'm not saying you're lying.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Then where am I?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: East of Orléans.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

beats.title: Orléans
beats.screenAction: The group resumes travel. Orléans and the siege are introduced only as practical local context.
beats.dialogueIntent: Give the player recognizable historical clues while keeping MC focused on location and survival.
beats.result: Orléans becomes the best nearby place to seek treatment, supplies, and answers.

script.text: The group starts moving again. MC walks beside the cart.
We're bound toward Orléans. Bad road for it, with the English around.
script.speaker: Civilian

script.text: English?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: MC looks from the unfamiliar clothes and banners to the road ahead.
I'm starting to think I'm very far from home.
script.speaker: MC

beats.title: Stay With Us
beats.screenAction: Julie gives her name and tells MC to stay with the group rather than wander off injured.
beats.dialogueIntent: Create a direct personal bond and a practical reason to travel together, not political allegiance.
beats.result: MC accepts temporary help and joins the group toward safer ground and Orléans.

script.text: I'm Julie.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: {{MC_NAME}}. Again, I suppose.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: I remembered.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: We're heading toward Orléans. If you're looking for answers, you'll have better luck there than bleeding beside the road.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Can you walk?
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Probably.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Not very convincing. Stay with us.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: All right. Until I figure this out.
script.speaker: MC

beats.title: Trouble Ahead
beats.screenAction: The lead escort detects armed movement ahead and halts the group.
beats.dialogueIntent: Immediate practical escalation into B01.
beats.result: Load CH01-B01 — Strangers on the Road.

script.text: The lead escort suddenly raises a hand. The cart stops.
Quiet.
script.speaker: Local escort

script.text: Armed voices carry from beyond the bend.
Julie shifts closer to the civilians and reaches for her sword.
Looks like your peaceful walk will have to wait.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: CH01-B01 — Strangers on the Road.

nodes.title: Strangers on the Road
nodes.summary: First mandatory France battle. Protect/escort the civilian group and supply cart from armed foragers/stragglers while MC remains attack-limited. Julie is already present; Hangaku Gozen and La Hire enter through the fight.

beats.title: Protect the Cart
beats.screenAction: Armed foragers/stragglers rush the road. Julie and the escorts form a defense while civilians pull behind the cart.
beats.dialogueIntent: Make the first France battle about protecting ordinary people rather than defeating every enemy.
beats.result: The group holds long enough to start moving civilians and supplies out of the kill zone.

script.text: Behind the cart! Move!
script.speaker: Local escort

script.text: Julie draws her sword and takes position between the attackers and the civilians.
Stay with the wounded and keep them moving.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Battle preview: MC can move, assist civilians, interact with the route/cart, and survive, but normal Attack remains disabled.
I can still help.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Then help them get clear.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

beats.title: An Arrow From Nowhere
beats.screenAction: A civilian is nearly cut off. A precise ranged strike from an unknown warrior interrupts the attacker before she enters the line herself.
beats.dialogueIntent: Introduce Hangaku by decisive action, not biography. Keep her identity hidden until dialogue earns it.
beats.result: A capable unknown warrior joins the defense and stabilizes the road flank.

script.text: One attacker breaks past the escort and closes on a civilian.
A missile strikes the attacker's weapon arm and knocks the blow aside.
A composed warrior steps into the road between the civilian and the next attacker.
Behind me.
script.speaker: Hangaku Gozen

script.text: She does not wait for thanks before turning back toward the threat.

beats.title: A Loud Reinforcement
beats.screenAction: Pressure builds on the opposite side until a rough-edged swordsman crashes into the attackers from the road.
beats.dialogueIntent: Contrast Hangaku's controlled entrance with La Hire's aggressive battlefield energy; keep his identity hidden until reveal.
beats.result: The attackers lose momentum and the civilians gain an escape route.

script.text: More armed men appear at the rear of the cart.
They're closing the road!
script.speaker: Local escort

script.text: A battered swordsman slams into the nearest attacker from the side.
You picked a damned poor road to rob today.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: He grins like the fight has finally improved his mood.

beats.title: Get Them Through
beats.screenAction: The improvised defenders create a corridor. MC focuses on getting civilians and the supply cart through while the others hold the attackers.
beats.dialogueIntent: Let MC contribute meaningfully without undoing the prologue defeat or attack limitation.
beats.result: Civilians and cart escape the immediate road threat.

script.text: Objective update: escort the civilians and cart through the open route.
MC braces one shoulder against the cart as a wheel catches in a rut.
Push!
script.speaker: MC

script.text: The cart breaks free while Julie, the unknown warrior, and the rough swordsman hold the road.
The group clears the ambush and reaches temporary shelter before nightfall.

beats.title: Names After Danger
beats.screenAction: Once the immediate danger passes, the two newcomers finally give their names.
beats.dialogueIntent: Keep the introductions short; the battle itself should have already defined their first impressions.
beats.result: Hangaku Gozen and La Hire become known to MC; the group moves to shelter.

script.text: At the edge of shelter, Julie finally lowers her sword.
You have a name?
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Hangaku Gozen.
script.speaker: Hangaku Gozen

script.text: La Hire.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: That sounded less like an introduction and more like a warning.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Good. You heard it properly.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: CH01-N03 — Shelter Before Nightfall.

nodes.title: Shelter Before Nightfall
nodes.summary: Post-B01 shelter, treatment, food and rest. MC builds early rapport with Julie, Hangaku and La Hire, then receives a cheap replacement sword after recovery.

beats.title: Food, Water, Bandages
beats.screenAction: At a rough shelter, Julie properly cleans and binds MC's injuries while the group eats and settles.
beats.dialogueIntent: Use recovery to let personalities breathe after the battle.
beats.result: MC is stable enough to rest and talk; the immediate road danger is behind them.

script.text: Julie tightens a clean wrap around MC's arm.
You were supposed to stay out of the fighting.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: I did.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: You ran directly toward three armed men.
script.speaker: Hangaku Gozen

script.text: I said I didn't fight them.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Julie fails to hide a short laugh.

beats.title: Not the Only Stranger
beats.screenAction: MC asks Hangaku where she comes from and realizes another exceptional traveler may also be far from home.
beats.dialogueIntent: Hint at broader displacement without explaining Story Worlds or Fracture cosmology.
beats.result: MC gains reason to suspect the strangeness is larger than a simple wrong turn.

script.text: Hangaku... where are you from?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Far enough that most people here have never heard the name.
script.speaker: Hangaku Gozen

script.text: So I'm not the only one.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Not the only one who is far from home.
script.speaker: Hangaku Gozen

script.text: She leaves the rest unanswered.

beats.title: A Usable Sword
beats.screenAction: La Hire notices the broken sword and points MC toward a cheap replacement among available gear.
beats.dialogueIntent: The replacement is ordinary and practical; it matters because MC can carry a complete sword again, not because it is special.
beats.result: MC obtains a cheap replacement sword but remains hesitant to use it in real combat.

script.text: La Hire turns the broken starting sword over once and snorts.
You're carrying this?
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: It used to be better.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Most things did.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: He points to a plain, worn but serviceable sword among the spare gear.
Take that one. It won't impress anyone, but it won't fold in half either.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: MC takes the replacement sword and tests its weight without drawing it fully.
CH01-N04 — Names That Should Mean Nothing.

nodes.title: Names That Should Mean Nothing
nodes.summary: Recovery and context deepen the contradiction: France, England, Orléans and Charles/the Dauphin mean nothing to MC, while Primora and Vaelkrath mean nothing to the others. Orléans becomes the practical route toward answers.

beats.title: France
beats.screenAction: Simple conversation names France, England, Orléans, and Charles/the Dauphin. None of them belong in MC's known world.
beats.dialogueIntent: Turn necessary context into a growing contradiction, not a history lecture.
beats.result: MC can no longer comfortably explain the situation as merely being somewhere distant in Vaelkrath.

script.text: This is France?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Yes.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: And England is actually called England.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Usually.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: Orléans. France. England. Charles, the Dauphin... none of those names mean anything to you.
script.speaker: Hangaku Gozen

script.text: Should they?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Nobody answers immediately.

beats.title: Where Is Vaelkrath?
beats.screenAction: Julie asks the question plainly: where is Vaelkrath supposed to be? MC realizes there is no map direction that can answer.
beats.dialogueIntent: Let MC reach fear and uncertainty before reaching a formal another-world conclusion.
beats.result: MC decides Orléans is the best route to information and a possible way home.

script.text: Where exactly did you say Vaelkrath was?
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: It's... everywhere. Primora is in Vaelkrath. The mountain road, the southern jungle, the coast—
script.speaker: MC

script.text: MC stops as the explanation becomes impossible to finish.
I need to get to Orléans.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: For what?
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Answers.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Good. We needed a reason to keep walking.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

beats.title: Leave at First Light
beats.screenAction: The group prepares to continue toward Orléans with the civilians and supplies.
beats.dialogueIntent: End recovery cleanly and move back into danger.
beats.result: The party route is set toward Orléans.

script.text: By first light, the cart is repacked and the road group is ready to move.
MC straps the cheap replacement sword at the hip.
CH01-B02 — The Road to Orléans.

nodes.title: The Road to Orléans
nodes.summary: Combat climax against an organized English siege-line road detachment/outer screen. The group opens the cordon, frees detainees and escapes before reinforcements. MC restores basic Attack with the cheap replacement sword when protecting Julie from immediate danger.

beats.title: The Cordon
beats.screenAction: An organized English road detachment stops the group, controls passage, and begins inspecting supplies and travelers.
beats.dialogueIntent: Start with pressure and negotiation, not instant combat. Establish that simply walking away will strand or expose the civilians.
beats.result: The checkpoint blocks safe passage and begins detaining travelers.

script.text: A timber barrier and armed detachment block the road. Several travelers are already being held aside.
Cart stays. Names and business.
script.speaker: English Sergeant

script.text: Julie steps forward before La Hire can.
Civilians. Food. We want passage.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Then you'll wait while we decide what belongs to you.
script.speaker: English Sergeant

script.text: Two soldiers begin pulling a messenger and another traveler toward the guarded side of the road.

beats.title: Open the Road
beats.screenAction: The detention turns violent. La Hire and Hangaku act to open the cordon and free the people being held.
beats.dialogueIntent: Escalate from passage dispute to rescue/breakthrough. MC still hesitates to draw the replacement sword.
beats.result: The barrier is breached and detainees begin escaping.

script.text: Enough talking.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: La Hire knocks the first guard off the barrier while Hangaku moves to the detainees.
Objective: open the cordon and free detainees. MC can move and assist but does not yet use normal Attack.
MC reaches for the replacement sword, stops, and instead helps pull a detainee clear.
Move. Don't wait for us.
script.speaker: MC

beats.title: Reinforcements
beats.screenAction: The detachment signals for reinforcements, including a mounted enemy presence that makes the escape window narrow.
beats.dialogueIntent: Raise urgency and preview Cavalry pressure without turning this into a full siege battle.
beats.result: The objective changes from holding ground to escaping before the road is sealed again.

script.text: A horn sounds from the far side of the road.
More coming!
script.speaker: Local escort

script.text: Mounted soldiers appear beyond the checkpoint.
Objective update: escape before reinforcements close the route.
Don't hold the road. Break through and go!
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

beats.title: Draw the Sword
beats.screenAction: An attacker slips through toward Julie while she is covering the retreat. MC reacts before thinking and finally draws the replacement sword.
beats.dialogueIntent: Pay off Julie helping MC in N01. The action is protective and instinctive, not a sudden cure for fear.
beats.result: MC regains basic Attack for the remainder of the battle preview.

script.text: Julie turns to shove a civilian toward the open route. An English soldier slips past the line behind her.
MC sees the raised weapon.
The replacement sword clears its sheath for the first time.
MC catches the incoming strike before it reaches Julie.
Basic Attack unlocked for MC in this draft battle intent.
Move!
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Julie meets MC's eyes for half a second, then turns back to the escape route.

beats.title: Breakthrough
beats.screenAction: The party and civilians complete the breakthrough before reinforcements can trap them.
beats.dialogueIntent: End on escape and survival, not annihilation of the English detachment.
beats.result: The road group escapes the outer screen and continues toward Orléans.

script.text: Final objective: reach the exit with the civilian group.
Hangaku covers the last detainees. La Hire forces the pursuing line to hesitate.
MC and Julie cross the final stretch with the cart behind them.
The group clears the checkpoint before the reinforcements can close the road.
CH01-N06 — The Maid Is Coming.

nodes.title: The Maid Is Coming
nodes.summary: Chapter resolution. Jeanne remains physically offscreen; conflicting rumors establish that the Maid is coming while MC continues toward Orléans seeking answers and a route home.

beats.title: After the Road
beats.screenAction: After the escape, Julie notices that MC finally used the replacement sword.
beats.dialogueIntent: Give the prologue defeat a small emotional echo without dumping backstory.
beats.result: Julie understands that MC's reluctance to fight came from something recent and frightening.

script.text: The group slows only after the road behind them is safely out of sight.
MC looks down at the cheap sword. The blade is still intact.
You can fight.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Apparently.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: You didn't seem very happy about it.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Last time I tried, it didn't go very well.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Julie lets the answer stand.

beats.title: The Maid
beats.screenAction: Passing travelers trade conflicting rumors about a young woman called the Maid who is expected toward Orléans.
beats.dialogueIntent: Jeanne remains offscreen. Present hope, doubt, and uncertainty rather than authoritative prophecy.
beats.result: The Maid becomes the chapter-ending hook without replacing MC's practical search for answers.

script.text: They say she's coming.
script.speaker: Traveler

script.text: The Maid?
script.speaker: Civilian

script.text: Another rumor.
script.speaker: Second Traveler

script.text: Maybe. Or maybe Orléans finally gets something worth believing in.
script.speaker: Traveler

script.text: Who's the Maid?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Depends who you ask.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

beats.title: Toward Orléans
beats.screenAction: The group continues toward Orléans. MC still wants answers and a route home; the Maid rumor becomes the next major story hook.
beats.dialogueIntent: Close the chapter quietly and keep MC's motivation personal rather than political.
beats.result: Chapter 1 ends with the party moving toward Orléans and the coming siege story.

script.text: Julie looks toward the distant road.
Come on. Maybe Orléans has your answers.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: MC follows with the replacement sword at the hip.
CHAPTER 1 COMPLETE
Next: Chapter 2 — The Siege of Orléans.

nodes.title: Behind the Walls
nodes.summary: MC enters Orléans and sees the siege as an exhausted civilian and military crisis rather than a heroic legend. Dunois becomes the command anchor while MC still searches for answers about home.

beats.title: A City Still Standing
beats.screenAction: The group enters Orléans through crowded defenses, wounded soldiers, damaged streets, ration lines, and hurried messengers.
beats.dialogueIntent: Ground the city before Jeanne appears. Dunois should read as capable and overburdened, not ceremonial.
beats.result: MC understands that Orléans is surviving under pressure and gains access to the local command network without becoming politically committed.

script.text: Orléans is loud with hammering, carts, bells, wounded men, and people arguing over food.
This is what everyone was trying to reach?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: This is what is left of it after months of siege.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: A tired commander crosses the street while giving three different orders without slowing.
La Hire. You brought more mouths.
script.speaker: Jean de Dunois

script.text: I brought people who can keep them attached to their bodies.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: Then I can use them. Jean de Dunois.
script.speaker: Jean de Dunois

script.text: {{MC_NAME}}. I was hoping somebody here had maps of places no one else has heard of.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: If your place exists on a map, we will look after we survive the week.
script.speaker: Jean de Dunois

script.text: CH02-N02 — The Maid Enters Orléans.

nodes.title: The Maid Enters Orléans
nodes.summary: Jeanne enters Orléans as a public symbol before MC meets her privately. The city projects hope and expectation onto a young woman MC can barely see through the crowd.

beats.title: The Maid
beats.screenAction: Crowds gather as Jeanne enters the city. MC sees banners, armor, and a young rider almost swallowed by the reaction around her.
beats.dialogueIntent: Keep Jeanne distant and human inside the spectacle. Do not validate prophecy or explain miracles.
beats.result: MC understands why the rumor mattered to Orléans, but still knows Jeanne only as the Maid seen by everyone else.

script.text: A wave of shouting rolls down the street before MC can see its cause.
What happened?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: She made it into the city.
script.speaker: Civilian

script.text: The Maid?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: A white banner rises above the crowd. Beneath it rides a young armored woman, visibly tired and trying to acknowledge everyone at once.
They look at her like the siege is already over.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: That is a dangerous amount of hope to put on one person.
script.speaker: Hangaku Gozen

script.text: The crowd closes and Jeanne disappears from view.
CH02-N03 — Beneath the Banner.

nodes.title: Beneath the Banner
nodes.summary: MC meets Jeanne directly at human scale. Bradamante also enters the Orléans group as a disciplined armored lancer, while the coming Saint-Loup assault pulls everyone toward the same immediate problem.

beats.title: Jeanne the Person
beats.screenAction: Away from the crowd, MC finds Jeanne eating quickly over a campaign table while Dunois reviews positions. Bradamante stands among the arriving fighters.
beats.dialogueIntent: Make Jeanne serious, young, tired, and direct. Her first bond with MC comes from recognizing another person who does not know what comes next.
beats.result: MC and Jeanne meet as people before fighting together; Bradamante is established as a new allied lancer for the coming assault.

script.text: The room is quieter than the street. Jeanne is halfway through a piece of bread when Dunois points MC toward the table.
This is the stranger from the eastern road.
script.speaker: Jean de Dunois

script.text: I have a name.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Good. So do I. Jeanne.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: I know. Half the city has been shouting it.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Jeanne almost smiles, then looks back at the marked positions outside the walls.
They want me to know what happens next.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: Do you?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: I know what I am going to try. That has to be enough.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: An armored lancer sets a helm beside the table.
Bradamante. If Saint-Loup is the road forward, I will take it with you.
script.speaker: Bradamante

script.text: Draft battle-party intent: Bradamante enters as an allied Lancer; La Hire provides the first clear Cavalry guest role for the siege offensives.
CH02-B01 — Saint-Loup.

nodes.title: Saint-Loup
nodes.summary: The first full siege offensive attacks Saint-Loup. MC fights as a functioning participant while Jeanne, La Hire, Bradamante, and the French force break an English outer position.

beats.title: Take the Bastille
beats.screenAction: French forces assault Saint-Loup under missile pressure and fortified resistance. La Hire uses mounted mobility around the approach while Bradamante opens safe pressure lanes for infantry.
beats.dialogueIntent: This is MC’s first battle entered willingly as a fighter in France. Keep the objective positional: breach and secure, not simple annihilation.
beats.result: The attackers breach Saint-Loup and force the defense to collapse.

script.text: Objective: breach the Saint-Loup defenses and secure the inner position.
Do not bunch under the arrows! Keep moving!
script.speaker: Jean de Dunois

script.text: La Hire rides hard across the exposed approach, forcing defenders to split their attention.
There. That gap.
script.speaker: Bradamante

script.text: I see it.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: MC advances with the assault instead of staying behind the civilians for the first time.
With me!
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

beats.title: After the Breach
beats.screenAction: The position falls. The immediate triumph is undercut by wounded soldiers and prisoners in the captured works.
beats.dialogueIntent: Do not turn the victory into a clean heroic tableau. Set up N05 by showing the human cost immediately.
beats.result: Saint-Loup is secured and the group returns to Orléans with a more complicated sense of victory.

script.text: The last organized resistance inside the position breaks.
Battle objective complete: Saint-Loup secured.
Cheers rise, then thin as the wounded are carried past.
We won.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Yes.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: You do not sound happy.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: I am. I just know what it cost.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: CH02-N05 — The Cost of Hope.

nodes.title: The Cost of Hope
nodes.summary: After Saint-Loup, MC and Jeanne compare what it means to help people when one is already being treated as a hero and the other still does not believe the word applies.

beats.title: Heroes
beats.screenAction: MC helps carry supplies among the wounded. Jeanne joins briefly after escaping another cluster of people demanding answers from her.
beats.dialogueIntent: Build the MC–Jeanne relationship through shared discomfort with the idea of heroism, not romance or prophecy.
beats.result: Jeanne sees that MC keeps helping without needing a grand reason; MC sees how exhausting it is to be treated as everyone’s answer.

script.text: MC stacks water beside the wounded while Jeanne finally slips away from a knot of officers and civilians.
Do they ever stop asking you what to do?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: No.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: That sounds terrible.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: It is also why they keep moving.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: Jeanne watches MC hand a cup of water to a wounded soldier.
You do that often.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: What?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Help first. Decide what it means later.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: Julie says that is how I get into trouble.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Then perhaps she is right.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: CH02-B02 — Across the Loire / The Augustins.

nodes.title: Across the Loire / The Augustins
nodes.summary: The campaign shifts across the Loire toward fortified positions around the Augustins. Mobility, crossings, and separated fronts become more important than the Saint-Loup assault.

beats.title: Across the River
beats.screenAction: The force crosses and reorganizes under fire. La Hire’s mounted movement connects separated pressure points while Hangaku and Bradamante keep the crossing from collapsing.
beats.dialogueIntent: Escalate from a single fortress assault into coordinated movement across constrained approaches.
beats.result: The French force establishes the attack and drives toward the Augustins position.

script.text: Objective: establish the crossing, protect the route, and open the approach to the Augustins.
If that crossing closes, half of us fight alone.
script.speaker: Hangaku Gozen

script.text: Then keep it open. I will carry orders between the fronts.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: La Hire wheels away before anyone can answer.
Does he always do that?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Yes.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Unfortunately.
script.speaker: Bradamante

beats.title: The Augustins Break
beats.screenAction: After sustained pressure the Augustins position gives way and the route toward the Tourelles becomes the next unavoidable objective.
beats.dialogueIntent: End with momentum but visible exhaustion. The Tourelles should feel harder, not like a victory lap.
beats.result: The Augustins fall and the assault line turns toward the Tourelles.

script.text: The defenders begin pulling back from the broken position.
Objective complete: Augustins position taken.
They are falling back.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Toward the Tourelles.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: Then we are not finished.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: No.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: CH02-B03 — The Tourelles.

nodes.title: The Tourelles
nodes.summary: The siege climax assaults the Tourelles. Jeanne is wounded, morale falters, and the objective honestly shifts to preventing collapse before she returns bandaged and the final assault resumes.

beats.title: The Wound
beats.screenAction: During the assault Jeanne is wounded and removed from the immediate line. The attack stalls as soldiers react to seeing the symbol of their hope fall.
beats.dialogueIntent: Treat the wound as dangerous and frightening. No miraculous healing.
beats.result: The battle objective changes from assault to hold/protect/reorganize while Jeanne is treated.

script.text: The assault compresses against the fortifications under heavy fire.
Jeanne jerks backward and falls among the front ranks.
Jeanne!
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Get her back! Now!
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: Objective changes: HOLD THE LINE. Protect the wounded, prevent a rout, and keep the assault route from collapsing.
Nobody runs. Not one step!
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: Jeanne is carried away from the immediate fighting for treatment.

beats.title: Return to the Line
beats.screenAction: After the line stabilizes, Jeanne returns visibly bandaged and insists on continuing. Morale recovers because the soldiers see her return, not because the wound disappears.
beats.dialogueIntent: The final push belongs to the whole force. Jeanne restores morale; the player completes the tactical objective.
beats.result: The final assault succeeds and the siege position collapses.

script.text: The line holds long enough for the panic to stop spreading.
A murmur begins behind the front.
Jeanne returns with the wound bound tightly, pale but standing.
You should be lying down.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Later.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: That is a terrible answer.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: It is the one I have.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: Objective update: resume the final assault and secure the Tourelles.
The French line surges forward again.
The Tourelles position falls. CH02-N08 — The Siege Is Lifted.

nodes.title: The Siege Is Lifted
nodes.summary: The English withdrawal resolves the siege without another mandatory battle. Orléans celebrates, while MC realizes the people here are no longer merely strangers between them and home.

beats.title: Eight Days of May
beats.screenAction: The city wakes to the English withdrawal and erupts into exhausted celebration. MC still has no map to Vaelkrath, but now has relationships they are unwilling to treat as temporary inconveniences.
beats.dialogueIntent: End on emotional attachment and the next campaign direction, not on a solved world mystery.
beats.result: Chapter 2 ends with the siege lifted and the route toward the Loire campaign / crown becoming the next story movement.

script.text: Church bells answer each other across Orléans. People spill into streets that were defensive positions the day before.
They are leaving.
script.speaker: Jean de Dunois

script.text: The English?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: The siege. It is over.
script.speaker: Jean de Dunois

script.text: MC looks at Julie, Hangaku, La Hire, Bradamante, and finally Jeanne.
I still do not know how to get home.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: I know.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: But?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: But you are not leaving today.
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: No. I guess I am not.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: There is another road now. The Loire first. Then Reims.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: CHAPTER 2 COMPLETE
Next: Chapter 3 — The Road to the Crown.

nodes.title: Beyond Orléans
nodes.summary: After the siege, the campaign turns from saving one city toward opening the Loire and carrying Charles toward Reims. Jean II d’Alençon becomes a central campaign commander while MC chooses to keep traveling with Jeanne.

beats.title: A Larger Road
beats.screenAction: The party leaves the immediate Orléans crisis behind and joins a larger campaign moving along the Loire. Alençon frames the next operations as a military road toward the king’s coronation.
beats.dialogueIntent: Expand the political scale without making MC suddenly care about dynastic legitimacy more than people.
beats.result: MC commits to the next leg because Jeanne and the group are going, while the road to Reims becomes the chapter goal.

script.text: The walls of Orléans recede behind a column of soldiers, carts, horses, and banners.
I thought winning Orléans meant we could rest.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: It meant we could start moving.
script.speaker: Jean II d’Alençon

script.text: Jean d’Alençon. We clear the Loire, then the road to Reims becomes possible.
script.speaker: Jean II d’Alençon

script.text: And the crown.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: You really intend to go all the way.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Yes.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: Then I am coming too.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: CH03-B01 — Jargeau.

nodes.title: Jargeau
nodes.summary: The campaign attacks Jargeau. William de la Pole, Earl of Suffolk, anchors the English defense as the French push from siege assault into open campaign warfare.

beats.title: Break Jargeau
characters: William de la Pole, Earl of Suffolk
beats.screenAction: The French assault Jargeau against determined English resistance under Suffolk.
beats.dialogueIntent: Make the battle a disciplined escalation from Orléans rather than another miraculous charge. Suffolk should read as a serious commander, not a disposable villain.
beats.result: Jargeau falls and Suffolk is taken out of the campaign, opening the next Loire positions.

script.text: Objective: breach Jargeau and force the English garrison to surrender or collapse.
They have momentum. Break it here.
script.speaker: William de la Pole, Earl of Suffolk

script.text: He knows what he is doing.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Good. Then beating him will matter.
script.speaker: Jean II d’Alençon

script.text: The French push through the defenses in successive waves instead of a single rush.
Forward! Keep the pressure!
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: By the battle’s end, organized resistance at Jargeau has collapsed and Suffolk is captured.
The Loire campaign continues west. CH03-N03 — Between Fortresses.

nodes.title: Between Fortresses
nodes.summary: The campaign moves through the Loire positions around Meung and Beaugency. Arthur de Richemont’s arrival creates political friction even as his strength helps pressure the English position.

beats.title: An Ally Nobody Invited
beats.screenAction: As Beaugency comes under pressure, Richemont arrives with Breton strength despite political distrust around him.
beats.dialogueIntent: Use Richemont to show that allies can be politically inconvenient. MC should understand the personal tension before the dynastic details.
beats.result: The campaign accepts Richemont’s practical help, but the political fracture inside the French side becomes visible to MC.

script.text: A fresh column approaches under Breton banners while officers around Alençon react with more suspicion than relief.
Those are ours, yes?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: That depends which argument you are asking about.
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: Arthur de Richemont. I brought soldiers, not a debate.
script.speaker: Arthur de Richemont

script.text: For today, soldiers are useful.
script.speaker: Jean II d’Alençon

script.text: That may be the kindest welcome I receive.
script.speaker: Arthur de Richemont

script.text: The army turns its attention back toward the English withdrawal and the road beyond Beaugency.
CH03-B02 — Patay.

nodes.title: Patay
nodes.summary: The French catch the retreating English near Patay. La Hire’s vanguard becomes central, while John Talbot’s disciplined reputation makes the sudden English collapse feel consequential rather than easy.

beats.title: Before the Line Sets
beats.screenAction: The French discover the English before their defensive deployment is fully settled and attack the vulnerable formation.
beats.dialogueIntent: This battle should feel fast, dangerous, and opportunity-driven. Talbot is formidable, but the English position is caught at the wrong moment.
beats.result: The French vanguard breaks the English field position before it can stabilize.

script.text: Objective: strike before the English line fully forms; prevent an organized withdrawal.
Now! Do not give them time to plant themselves!
script.speaker: La Hire

script.text: Mounted French forces surge toward the incomplete English position.
Hold the line!
script.speaker: John Talbot

script.text: That one is not running.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Talbot. He rarely does.
script.speaker: Jean II d’Alençon

beats.title: A Commander Captured
beats.screenAction: The English field force collapses and Talbot is captured. MC sees that a famous enemy can lose because conditions, timing, and people failed around him—not because history guarantees it.
beats.dialogueIntent: Let Talbot retain dignity and danger in defeat. This is useful groundwork for his later importance.
beats.result: Patay opens the road toward Reims and establishes Talbot as a major opposing figure rather than a one-battle enemy.

script.text: The English formation breaks into retreat and surrender.
Talbot is brought under guard, furious but composed.
You caught an army before it was ready. Do not mistake that for the end of the war.
script.speaker: John Talbot

script.text: I will remember.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Good. I would rather my enemies learn something.
script.speaker: John Talbot

script.text: Jeanne looks past the prisoners toward the road north-east.
Reims.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: CH03-N05 — The Road to Reims.

nodes.title: The Road to Reims
nodes.summary: With the Loire campaign won, the army moves toward Reims. Charles VII enters the chapter directly, and MC sees the political meaning of Jeanne’s campaign becoming larger than any one battlefield.

beats.title: The King Before the Crown
beats.screenAction: On the march, MC finally speaks directly with Charles while towns and gates along the route become political choices rather than tactical objectives.
beats.dialogueIntent: Keep Charles human and cautious. The story should not require MC to instantly revere him.
beats.result: MC understands that Jeanne’s goal is not simply military victory but making Charles publicly king at Reims.

script.text: The campaign road is quieter than the battles, but every town ahead carries another decision about opening its gates.
You are the one from nowhere.
script.speaker: Charles VII

script.text: That is becoming an uncomfortable reputation.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: I know something about uncomfortable reputations.
script.speaker: Charles VII

script.text: Jeanne says the road ends at Reims.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: If the city receives us, it begins there. A crown is useful because people agree it means something.
script.speaker: Charles VII

script.text: And if they do not agree?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: Then France continues arguing with itself.
script.speaker: Charles VII

script.text: MC looks toward Jeanne riding farther up the column.
CH03-N06 — The Crown at Reims.

nodes.title: The Crown at Reims
nodes.summary: Charles is crowned at Reims. The chapter closes on the apparent fulfillment of Jeanne’s great public mission and the first subtle suggestion that the world does not feel as settled as it should.

beats.title: The Crown
beats.screenAction: The coronation is primarily narrative. MC watches Charles crowned and sees Jeanne briefly without the battlefield around her.
beats.dialogueIntent: Deliver a genuine emotional high, then introduce only a restrained anomaly clue after it. Do not explain the cosmology.
beats.result: Chapter 3 ends with Charles crowned, MC and Jeanne closer, and a faint wrongness that points toward the darker second half of the Saga.

script.text: Reims — 17 July 1429
The cathedral is filled with ceremony, heat, armor, cloth, incense, and people trying not to miss history happening in front of them.
Charles receives the crown. The sound inside the cathedral swells.
So that is it?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: For this road.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: You do not sound finished.
script.speaker: MC

script.text: I do not think France is finished.
script.speaker: Jeanne d’Arc

script.text: For a heartbeat, light bends strangely across a distant pane of glass. MC turns toward it.
Did you see that?
script.speaker: MC

script.text: See what?
script.speaker: Julie d’Aubigny

script.text: The light is normal again.
CHAPTER 3 COMPLETE
Next: Chapter 4 — The Maid Falls.
